hook_type: letter tease (bait and switch): three letters everyone types, one is not who you think

lines.text: G. P. T. You'd think all three letters are OpenAI's. One isn't.
lines.see: Three huge chrome letters G P T in a dark void, the T flickers wrong

lines.text: G, generative. It creates things that never existed.
lines.see: G ignites, particles assemble into shapes out of nothing

lines.text: P, pre-trained. It read a huge chunk of the internet.
lines.see: A storm of glowing pages pours into the P
Spotlight snaps onto T, everything else goes dark, low hit
T turns, four-colour glow, a Google-style campus block rises behind it

lines.text: In 2017, eight Google researchers wrote one paper. It invented the Transformer.
lines.see: A 3D paper, Attention Is All You Need, eight figures standing on it, the T assembles from its pages

lines.text: The T. The engine inside ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude.
lines.see: T becomes a glowing engine core, three app cubes each with the same core inside

lines.text: Google patented it. Then let the whole world use it.
lines.see: PATENTED stamp slams, then the vault opens and copies of the T fly out across a globe

lines.text: All eight inventors? Every single one has left Google.
lines.see: The eight figures walk off the paper one by one, counter 8 to 0

lines.text: Google paid 2.7 billion dollars to get one back. In June, he joined OpenAI.
lines.see: Last figure, $2.7B price tag, then he crosses to the OpenAI side

lines.text: So should Google have kept the T a secret?
lines.see: Back to G P T, the T hangs between two sides, comment bubble. Loops to frame 0

facts.claim: GPT stands for Generative Pre-trained Transformer; OpenAI's 2018 paper 'Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training'
The Transformer was introduced in 'Attention Is All You Need' (2017) by eight authors at Google Brain / Google Research
Google holds US patent 10,452,978, 'Attention-based sequence transduction neural networks'
All eight co-authors have now left Google
Noam Shazeer, brought back via Google's ~$2.7B Character.AI deal (Aug 2024), left Google for OpenAI in June 2026
ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude are built on the Transformer architecture

publish.title: One letter in ChatGPT belongs to Google #shorts
publish.caption:
G and P are OpenAI's. The T was invented at Google in 2017, patented, then given to the world. Now all eight inventors have left.

Should Google have kept it secret? 👇

Comment PAPER and I'll send you the guide: the paper, the eight people, and where they went.

Inside AI, episode 2.
